messages:
Alex G: Heads up — seeing duplicated token counts on streaming resumes for a customer, looks like telemetry and billing both show two active streams after a resume.
Priya N: I noticed weird metrics spikes last night, might be related.
Sam T: is this on hosted or dedicated?
Alex G: Hosted control plane but customer routed to a dedicated pool (sticky routing). Resume happened right after a short disconnect.
Tina L: can you drop example logs / headers?
Alex G: pasted logs below:
```
[INFO] 2026-03-18T11:02:14Z resume request tenant=acme client_id=abc123 resume_token=tok_zz session_id=s1
[INFO] 2026-03-18T11:02:15Z accept resume tenant=acme client_id=abc123 resume_token=tok_zz session_id=s2
```
Priya N: oh, session_id changed on accept — that would create two concurrent sessions in metrics.
Sam T: why would accept allocate a new session? router should reattach to existing session if resume_token matches.
Michael C: there's a codepath where router allocates a session per connection if it can't reach the original node; sticky-routing uses a client_id->node map with TTL, sounds like TTL expired.
Priya N: TTL is 30s for the sticky map in prod config, resume happened ~40s after disconnect.
Alex G: that explains it — resume created a new session on another node while the old one lingered for a bit. Console saw both as active.
Tina L: immediate mitigation options: bump sticky TTL to 2m, or dedupe on resume_token at ingress.
Sam T: don't want to bump TTL globally without product signoff. Safer: idempotent resume handling keyed by resume_token. If token seen recently, reuse previous session_id.
Michael C: agree on idempotency cache. Implement a small in-memory cache: resume_token -> session_id with 60s expiry. Low-risk and local to the router.
Alex G: I can prototype that today.
Priya N: I'll add a console-side dedupe as a bandaid to avoid billing confusion (group streams by resume_token in aggregated metrics).
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0318-4 streaming-resume-metrics-duplication
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: branch alex/g/resume-proto -> CI queued
Sam T: please add unit tests: resume_token idempotency + e2e simulating TTL expiry and multi-node accept.
Tina L: also file an RFC if we want to change sticky TTL defaults — product needs to sign off on behavior changes.
Alex G: PR up when ready, will post link here.
Alex G: quick prototype PR: https://git.redwood/dev/repo/pull/1234 :eyes:
Priya N: adding incident link to postmortem tracking doc: /incidents/INC-2026-0318-4
Michael C: once we merge, canary for 2h before full rollout.
Alex G: thanks all :thumbsup:
